decisions.summary: Single-reviewer scope accepted: one dead-chain removal intent in one commit
decisions.reason: scope_reviewed: the PR diff is one coherent intent — remove the production-dead human PR summary renderer chain from src/pr-manager.js (-583 lines, zero callers confirmed by three independent reviews in story-vibepro-uiux-intake-gate-pr-summary-surfaces), delete the two tests that pinned the dead exports, and add the story doc, spec pointer/contract doc, design registry entry, config registration, and one story e2e test. review_owner_map: a single reviewer owns the whole surface; the gate stage gate_evidence review role covers src/pr-manager.js and the test/docs surfaces in one pass since every deleted function is unreachable and the live-path behavior is pinned by the pre-existing concise-body contract tests. related_file_blast_radius: production blast radius is zero by construction (all deleted functions had no callers; shared helpers retained and pinned by ac:2). split_plan: no split needed — splitting docs from code would leave the registry/spec pointing at unremoved code or vice versa.
